五人的一举一动都在王野的探查下，就见他们先在倒地的人脑袋上先补一枪，然后开始搜身。这一切都在无声中进行。王野觉得这绝对是群长年在山里打家劫舍的土匪。

王野清楚的看见，领头的从尸体身上搜出了几个小小的红布包。看样子被灭的一方应该是参把头，这个时候正是进山抬参的好时候。这帮人应该是专门对他们下手的。

王野就这样静静的观察着他们，这帮人搜完东西就在不远的地方挖了五个大坑，把其中五具尸体简单掩埋了，剩下的就这样曝尸荒野。

王野见五人掩埋尸体后就走了，他在后面悄悄的跟上，始终保持精神力的最远距离。就这样走了一个多小时，他们来到了一山顶，这里有一个小寨子，仅有一条小路可以上山。

躲在不远处的王野看着这个寨子，房子倒是不少。可是大部分都已经破损了，在一座最大的房子里，王野探查到有十五个人正在说话。王野虽然身手了得，枪法精准，可是也没有托大到可以一挑十五，而且还是一群悍匪。

王野悄悄的撤出寨子，在上山的小路口不远处埋伏了下来。午饭王野就简单的趴着吃了几个馒头，一直到了两点多钟这帮人才出来。气的王野暗骂一句：“真踏马不敬业，中午还休息这么半天。”

这次出来了八个人，领头的还是上午见的那个。这八人一路出着牛皮，完全不知道他们被人跟踪了。一直走了一个多小时，这八个人才找了一个地方休息。

王野打量着这个地方，真是山清水秀，旁边还有一条小溪，王野觉得这地方真不错，做他们的长眠之地都算是他们的造化了。

王野悄悄的把两把枪检查了一遍，躲在一棵大树后瞄准射击，第一枪就把领头的毙掉，直到王野打掉对方三人后他们才反应过来，其他五人赶紧寻找掩体。

接下来就是有来有往的对射，王野可是有上帝视角的存在，怎么可能被他们击中。在他们射击的空隙，王野一次次的探身，每一次探身就是一条生命的逝去。

直到剩下最后两个人时，对方喊话了：“大爷，俺们大当家的是黑风口，穿山虎。不知道大爷是哪路英雄，兴许和我们大当家的还有交情呢？”

王野直接喊道：“先别跟老子废话，把武器放下我跟你们好好聊。”

胡子听见王野的口音是外地人继续喊道：“大爷是过江龙吧，俺们也不是软柿子，寨子里百八十号兄弟还是有的，这次你高抬贵手放我们兄弟一马，来日必有厚报。”

王野信他这话就是傻子，也不废话，对着两人躲避的大树就是两枪。两人见王野不依不饶，只能继续喊道：“大爷，我们放下武器能留一条命吗？”

王野：“别踏马废话，先放下武器，双手抱头出来再说。”

两人互看一眼，把手里的枪扔了出去，双手抱头从掩体后慢慢的走了出来。他们的一举一动都在王野探查下，就在两人出来刚要喊话时，王野抬手就是两枪。

Every move of the five people was under Wang Ye's observation. They first shot the fallen man in the head, and then began to search him.All this happens in silence.Wang Ye felt that these were definitely a group of bandits who had been robbing homes in the mountains for many years.

Wang Ye clearly saw that the leader found several small red cloth bags from the body.It seems that the party that was killed should be the leader of the ginseng. This is a good time to go into the mountain to carry the ginseng.This group of people should be targeting them specifically.

Wang Ye just watched them quietly. After searching the things, the group dug five large pits not far away, briefly buried five of the corpses, and left the rest exposed in the wilderness.

Wang Ye saw the five people burying the bodies and left. He followed quietly behind them, always maintaining the longest distance with his mental power.After walking like this for more than an hour, they arrived at the top of a mountain. There was a small village with only one path leading up the mountain.

Wang Ye, who was hiding not far away, looked at the village. There were quite a few houses.But most of them were damaged. In the largest house, Wang Ye detected fifteen people talking.Although Wang Ye was very skilled and accurate with his marksmanship, he was not powerful enough to challenge fifteen people, and they were still a group of tough bandits.

Wang Ye quietly withdrew from the village and laid an ambush not far from the trailhead up the mountain.For lunch, Wang Ye simply lay down and ate a few steamed buns, and it wasn't until about two o'clock that the group came out.An angry Wang Ye cursed secretly: "It's so disrespectful to work hard and take such a long break at noon."

Eight people came out this time, and the leader was the same one they met in the morning.These eight people were fooling around all the way, completely unaware that they were being followed.After walking for more than an hour, these eight people found a place to rest.

Wang Ye looked at this place. It was really beautiful with beautiful mountains and clear waters, and there was a creek next to it. Wang Ye felt that this place was really nice. It was their good fortune to be their final resting place.

Wang Ye quietly checked the two guns, hid behind a big tree, took aim and fired, killing the leader with the first shot. They didn't react until Wang Ye killed the other three, and the other five hurriedly found cover.

What followed was a back-and-forth exchange of shots. Wang Ye had a God's perspective, how could he be hit by them.In the gaps between their shooting, Wang Ye leaned out again and again, and every time he leaned forward, a life was lost.

When the last two people were left, the other party called out: "Uncle, our leader is Hei Fengkou and Pangolin Tiger. I don't know what kind of hero you are. Maybe you still have friendship with our leader?"

Wang Ye shouted directly: "Don't talk nonsense to me yet. Put down your weapon and I will have a good chat with you."

Huzi heard that Wang Ye's accent was that of an outsider and continued to shout: "You are a dragon who has crossed the river, right? We are not soft persimmons. There are still brothers No. 180 in the village. This time you are so generous and let our brothers go, and you will be richly rewarded in the future."

Wang Ye believed that he was a fool, and he didn't talk nonsense. He shot two shots at the big tree where the two of them were hiding.Seeing Wang Ye's reluctance, the two of them could only continue to shout: "Uncle, can we save a life by putting down our weapons?"

Wang Ye: "Don't talk nonsense. Put down your weapons first, put your head in your hands and come out."

The two looked at each other, threw away the guns in their hands, put their heads in their hands and slowly walked out from behind the bunker.Their every move was under the scrutiny of Wang Ye. Just when the two came out and were about to shout, Wang Ye raised his hand and fired two shots.
